heading: Reset your password
body_text: We received a request to reset the password for your account. Click the button below to choose a new password.
expiry_notice: This link will expire in 1 hour. If you didn't request a password reset, no action is needed.
sub_text: If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this link into your browser: https://example.com/reset?token=abc123
footer_text: You received this email because a password reset was requested for your account.
